observations: Three photos show a black mid-tower PC case with a transparent side panel.
The interior has RGB lighting on fans and possibly the motherboard or GPU.
A large cooler with a fan is visible on the CPU, with a blue sticker that may be a brand logo.
The GPU is visible with 'RADEON' written in red on the side, indicating an AMD graphics card.
Cables are sleeved and routed neatly.

The case has a mesh front panel and stands on four feet.

RAM sticks are visible but no labels or capacity markings are readable. The seller's text is unverified.
No drives are visible in the photos. The seller's text is unverified.
